name: Restaurant „Nova Posta“
kurzbeschreibung:
**Restaurant „Nova Posta“ in Schwangau**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the **Alps**, just steps away from **Neuschwanstein** and **Hohenschwangau** castles. At **Restaurant „Nova Posta“**, you’ll savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schweinsbraten**, and **Käsespätzle**, all crafted with local ingredients.

The cozy, rustic atmosphere—with its wooden beams and warm lighting—makes it the perfect spot to unwind after a day of exploring **Tirol**. Whether you’re craving hearty mountain fare or a light snack, this family-run gem delivers flavors that tell a story of **Tirol’s** culinary heritage.

Don’t miss their famous **Apfelstrudel** for dessert or a glass of crisp **Tiroler Wein** to toast your adventure. A true taste of **Schwangau** awaits!
